item.title: Myna: Monospace typeface designed for symbol-heavy programming languages
item.description:
📝 Do you ever feel like your font treats symbols as second-class glyphs. Myna (Gracula religiosa 🐦‍⬛) is a monospace font which aims to bring harmony to your editor by treating symbols as first-class glyphs alongside alphanumeric characters. com/sayyadirfanali/Myna.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/sayyadirfanali/Myna

item.title: Ribir: Non-intrusive GUI framework for Rust/WASM
item.description:
📝 Ribir - Non-intrusive GUI Framework for Rust Use Rust to build multi-platform applications from a single codebase. Your focus should be on designing your data structure and its APIs. Widgets compose system has four kinds of widgets to support you can implement your widget in different ways: function widget and Compose, from other widgets composition.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/RibirX/Ribir
